parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Pour approximately 75 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker labelled A . Place the lid on the beaker and place the thermometer through the hole in the lid and into the water as shown in Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) When the temperature shown on the thermometer stops rising record in Table 2.1 the temperature θ at time t = 0 s and immediately start the stopclock.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Record in the table the temperature of the water at 30 s intervals from t = 30 s until you have a total of seven values up to time t = 180 s. [2]
